steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hey. What's the situation?

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Not too good. There's only a couple of devils left on the lower level...

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But they're all battle-hardened mercenaries, and horrible at that. Give them a single screw, and they'd come up with a hundred ways to kill you with it.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: In terms of combat ability, we're about even. In terms of numbers, we've only got half theirs.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uh, do you have a but? I'm gonna lose all the feeling in my legs...

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yeah. 'But' the mercs are having some interteam strife. At least the bunch outside are. The ones below us right now, I'm not too sure.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You know that's not good news, right? Ugh, ow... that guy just now was a ruthless bastard...

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If you've done emergency treatment, you're good. Think of something else for now, distract yourself.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...It's gotten hotter and hotter up above. Ever since just now, the action up there's gotten a little scary... and, uh, well, how do I put it? Makes it a little hard to breathe.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I said distract yourself, not think about it all!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Amiya. Amiya's alright, isn't she? And that Lungmen officer. Uh, I only met her once... but when I think about how they're dealing with... with... uh, what was it?

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Give it a rest, you're starting to talk in tongues. Actually, you've lost plenty of blood—hold on, we've got news.

steps.name: Panicked Voice
steps.text: It's me. I'm nearly at ground level—

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...What's the situation? The enemy?

steps.name: Panicked Voice
steps.text: Stroke of good luck. The Arts explosion just now at the top of the tower was like a volcano erupting. Engulfed the floor we were holding. We dispatched a few sentries in all the chaos, and the rest of them had to evacuate down to open ground—

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I thought they'd be defending this place to the death...

steps.name: Panicked Voice
steps.text: Maybe they all had a premonition of sorts. They all know, what's going on up there is beyond any 'tactical' level of foresight now—

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait... what's going on! ?

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Grab on to me!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait... the—the fire's spreading?! What the hell's even flammable here?!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: High heat... It's just like the intel said, this is Talulah's doing...!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Quit standing there! What do we do now?!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh—let's go this way, join up with everyone else! Wait up, is your leg okay now?!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Distracting myself!

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Confirm all comms! For the time being, no casualties!

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Calm your hustle. Those mercs haven't gone far. They're confirming the situation, prying for opportunities...

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Command tower got caught up in a sudden explosion at the top, and now it's fallen into... momentary peace.

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What part of this screams peace to you?! A—Amiya's group are okay, right?

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Mm... well, with that going on at the tower top, I'd say we're practically the picture of peace.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: F... finally—!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't drop your guard, we're still—

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: W—why'd you go mute? Hello—?

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What's so interesting about the sky? Is something going on at the tower...?

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Wait, i—is that an... orb of light? A ball... a ball of fire? A halo? What IS that?

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Arts.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Arts?

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ah! I've been making a record. Since the start, that first huge sound, the flames and heated airstreams have burst through the building's dome. From beneath the tower, to the naked eye, it looks like...
Like the afterglow of the setting sun.
Like the death of Infected as successive as the waves.
Like rage.
Like this city placed in ruin.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...I don't think I'm particularly perceptive compared to the rest of you, but I know more or less what you want to say here, really.

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That'd be the leader of Reunion's...

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Heat and flame.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But heat and flame... shouldn't be things so fearful.

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Mm. That ball of light. That's one... two people's. No, perhaps even more than that, even more rage...

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So that's... Talulah?

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It isn't. Or put another way, it's not just her. Not by far. Everyone knows the leader of Reunion as the intel described her, but I can't draw a line between that young little dragon and what I'm seeing now at all...

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Just what... just what happened up there?

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Is there anyone else in the command tower?!

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Then we need to go help them!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait! Keep your head down!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: —Enemies have left the command tower! Go find them!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Block this place off. Don't give them the chance to seek aid.

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wh—what do we do now?!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Maybe we should go back and help Amiya—

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: —No.

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Only Amiya... Only Amiya can do this. She can. I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I believe in her. That's the only reason I have for standing here now.

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: And...

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: And she promised me. On my next paid leave, she'd tag along with me to hit the streets... and no leader's allowed to eat their words.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Then until Amiya comes back clutching victory, we can't relinquish the control tower. At the very least, we hold on until Dr. Kal'tsit arrives.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We—

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wh—wait, something's cutting the sky apart! Uh, that—whatever that is!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: —Did you hear that! ? It happened again!

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...A sword? Right, that Lungmen officer's a sword-wielder, isn't she...

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: C-Could a sword do this?!

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...I'll hold the mercs off outside the control tower. You guys, back in. Rescue the remaining people. Secure an evacuation route that hasn't been destroyed.

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: How are you gonna hold alone against that many Sarkaz?

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'll go with her.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You guys, go back in now. Move.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: ...Rhodes doesn't have many left. Tell the other teams to haul the net in. We'll be going this way...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Crash their defensive line ASAP. Their deaths will be our greatest bargaining chips.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Tired Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Alright!

steps.name: Panicked Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't you push it now! They've got a lot of people!

steps.name: Steady Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...It's been forever. Us two, fighting side by side, eyeing for a chance to ambush the enemy.
The two battle-hardened Operators hold tight their weapons in mutual rapport, and the Sarkazs' press on towards them menacingly.
Neither side takes their eyes off the other.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...For sure.

steps.name: Seasoned Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So about your vacation. You two still need a bag-carrier?
